caption: The drawing features two rectangular textile samples with zigzag-cut edges, placed vertically one above the other against a light beige background. The upper sample has a repeated pattern of brown fern-like shapes arranged diagonally inside light beige bands, creating a woven, basket-like appearance. The lower sample displays a pattern composed of repeating black semicircular shapes forming six rectangular clusters against a beige background, with the remaining areas filled with a faint crisscross grid in the same beige color. Both samples are bordered by a slight gray shadow, giving a three-dimensional effect. The left side of the image contains faint, unfinished lines and smudges in brown, while the edges of the paper are clean except for a few minor orange-brown stains.
title: Vest Material
